fields.description:
Choose how penalties are calculated.
Factor: deducted_minutes_factor × minute_rate × penalty_minutes (e.g. 2.0 doubles each penalty minute against the employee's per-minute salary).
Fixed Per Hour: flat rate_per_hour / 60 × penalty_minutes (e.g. 50 currency/hour regardless of salary).
Penalty Matrix: escalating % of the daily rate per violation count in the period (e.g. 1st = 50% of a day, 2nd = 100%, 3rd = 150%).
fields.label: Penalty Type
fields.options:
Factor
Fixed Per Hour
Penalty Matrix

fields.description: Multiplier applied to each penalty minute. Formula: factor × minute_rate × penalty_minutes, where minute_rate = base_salary / month_days / working_minutes_per_day. Use 1.0 for a straight per-minute deduction; values above 1.0 amplify the penalty.
fields.label: Deducted Factor

fields.description: Hourly deduction amount (currency). Internally divided by 60 to get a per-minute rate: rate_per_hour / 60 × penalty_minutes. Independent of employee salary.
fields.label: Rate Per Hour
